\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 235-238 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R243-first-pass-words-from-chapters-235-238}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a hobby and a memory.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item sharp, available, enough, free of charge, unemployed
  \item stingy, funny, interesting, crazy, loyal
  \item snowy, wild, tame, alive, dead
  \item crisp, juicy, curious, strict, hard-working
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Sharp? (\textbf{\fa{تیز}}, \emph{tiz}.) Available? (\textbf{\fa{موجود}}, \emph{mojud}.) Enough? (\textbf{\fa{کافی}}, \emph{kâfi}.) Free of charge? (\textbf{\fa{مجانی}}, \emph{majâni}.) Unemployed? (\textbf{\fa{بیکار}}, \emph{bikâr}.) Stingy? (\textbf{\fa{خسیس}}, \emph{khasis}.) Funny? (\textbf{\fa{بامزه}}, \emph{bâmaze}.) Interesting? (\textbf{\fa{جالب}}, \emph{jâleb}.) Crazy? (\textbf{\fa{دیوانه}}, \emph{divâne}.) Loyal? (\textbf{\fa{وفادار}}, \emph{vafâdâr}.) Snowy? (\textbf{\fa{برفی}}, \emph{barfi}.) Wild? (\textbf{\fa{وحشی}}, \emph{vahshi}.) Tame? (\textbf{\fa{اهلی}}, \emph{ahli}.) Alive? (\textbf{\fa{زنده}}, \emph{zende}.) Dead? (\textbf{\fa{مرده}}, \emph{morde}.) Crisp? (\textbf{\fa{ترد}}, \emph{tord}.) Juicy? (\textbf{\fa{آبدار}}, \emph{âbdâr}.) Curious? (\textbf{\fa{کنجکاو}}, \emph{konjkâv}.) Strict? (\textbf{\fa{سختگیر}}, \emph{sakhtgir}.) Hard-working? (\textbf{\fa{زحمتکش}}, \emph{zahmatkesh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 239-243 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R243-second-pass-words-from-chapters-239-243}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a kettle and a teapot.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a kettle, a teapot, a handkerchief, a basket, rubbish
  \item a button, a sleeve, an umbrella, a chick, herbs
  \item a pear, a fig, a tangerine, mixed nuts, a dessert
  \item a loan, a cheque, petrol, a sentence, a dictionary
  \item a ceremony, a competition, a film, a hobby, a memory
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A kettle? (\textbf{\fa{کتری}}, \emph{ketri}.) A teapot? (\textbf{\fa{قوری}}, \emph{quri}.) A handkerchief? (\textbf{\fa{دستمال}}, \emph{dastmâl}.) A basket? (\textbf{\fa{سبد}}, \emph{sabad}.) Rubbish? (\textbf{\fa{زباله}}, \emph{zobâle}.) A button? (\textbf{\fa{دکمه}}, \emph{dokme}.) A sleeve? (\textbf{\fa{آستین}}, \emph{âstin}.) An umbrella? (\textbf{\fa{چتر}}, \emph{chatr}.) A chick? (\textbf{\fa{جوجه}}, \emph{juje}.) Herbs? (\textbf{\fa{سبزی}}, \emph{sabzi}.) A pear? (\textbf{\fa{گلابی}}, \emph{golâbi}.) A fig? (\textbf{\fa{انجیر}}, \emph{anjir}.) A tangerine? (\textbf{\fa{نارنگی}}, \emph{nârangi}.) Mixed nuts? (\textbf{\fa{آجیل}}, \emph{âjil}.) A dessert? (\textbf{\fa{دسر}}, \emph{deser}.) A loan? (\textbf{\fa{وام}}, \emph{vâm}.) A cheque? (\textbf{\fa{چک}}, \emph{chek}.) Petrol? (\textbf{\fa{بنزین}}, \emph{benzin}.) A sentence? (\textbf{\fa{جمله}}, \emph{jomle}.) A dictionary? (\textbf{\fa{فرهنگ}}, \emph{farhang}.) A ceremony? (\textbf{\fa{مراسم}}, \emph{marâsem}.) A competition? (\textbf{\fa{مسابقه}}, \emph{mosâbeqe}.) A film? (\textbf{\fa{فیلم}}, \emph{film}.) A hobby? (\textbf{\fa{سرگرمی}}, \emph{sargarmi}.) A memory? (\textbf{\fa{خاطره}}, \emph{khâtere}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
